items.title: Sabbir leads Bangladesh HP to second straight win in Top End Series
items.summary: Sabbir Rahman smashed a half-century as Bangladesh HP secured a three-wicket victory over Hobart Hurricanes Academy in the Top End T20 Series at Marrara Oval in Darwin on Sunday.

items.title: Cummins hails 'sharp' Australia after innings victory against Bangladesh
items.summary: Australia captain Pat Cummins praised his side for "all looking sharp" in a crushing innings and 51-run thrashing of Bangladesh in Mackay on Sunday as they emphatically bounced back from losing the first Test.

items.title: Shanto hopes Bangladesh 'do it' in South Africa after Darwin conquest
items.summary: "I don't want to point finger at anyone in particular but we played poorly as a team," Shanto said after the two-day loss in Mackay

items.title: Shanto wants more SENA Tests after Bangladesh rise to No. 6 in rankings
items.summary: Bangladesh drew their first series in Australia in 23 years, and rose above No. 9 on the ICC Test rankings for the first time

items.title: Starc claims 10 to demolish Bangladesh in two days
items.summary: It became the second-shortest Test ever played on Australian soil after Bangladesh were bundled for 95 on the second day

items.title: From historic high to humiliating low: Bangladesh see both sides of the coin Down Under
items.summary: Yet Shanto insisted the Mackay defeat should not erase what Bangladesh achieved a week earlier.

items.title: Shanto calls for regular Australia tours, questions pitch scrutiny
items.summary: Shanto hopes that more regular opportunities against top teams and in difficult conditions can help turn such breakthroughs into sustained progress.

items.title: No excuses for batting collapse: Shanto

items.title: Bangladesh rise to record sixth in Test rankings
